groups.name: App and menu
groups.about: The frame around every page: app name, side menu, phone tab bar, language switch, sign-out.

groups.name: Sign-in
groups.about: The sign-in page. In the new app it asks for the password only (no name).

groups.name: Home
groups.about: The first page: greeting, next meeting card, numbers, "Needs attention", "Coming up".

groups.name: Month overview
groups.about: The month page: every meeting in a month, open slots, creating several weeks at once.

groups.name: Create or edit
groups.about: The schedule editor: picking the date, filling each part, checks, saving, undo.

groups.name: Slips and printing
groups.about: Slips, schedule sheets, the S-140, the CSV and the WhatsApp cards and messages.

groups.name: Reminders
groups.about: WhatsApp reminders and calendar links for everyone with a part soon.

groups.name: Participants
groups.about: The people list: adding, editing, families, away dates and suspensions.

groups.name: Workbook PDF
groups.about: Uploading the Life and Ministry Meeting Workbook and correcting the parts it reads.

groups.name: Reports
groups.about: How often each person had a part.

groups.name: Admin
groups.about: Blank forms, backups, settings and the change log.

groups.name: Change log lines
groups.about: One line per change, shown in Admin → Change log. Short past-tense phrases.

groups.name: Errors
groups.about: Error pages and messages when something goes wrong.

groups.name: Shared words
groups.about: Words used on many screens. Several also print on documents.

groups.name: Printed documents
groups.about: Wording printed on schedule sheets, WhatsApp cards and messages, and calendar entries.

groups.name: Workbook keywords
groups.about: NOT translations: the exact words the printed Dangme workbook uses, so the app can read the workbook PDF. Most are already filled in from the workbook you sent.

notes.app.name: NEW. The new app's name (browser tab, header, sign-in page).

notes.kw.sec_ministry: Section heading exactly as printed in the Dangme workbook.
notes.kw.sec_living: Section heading exactly as printed in the Dangme workbook. Ga: "HII SHI AKƐ KRISTOFONYO".
notes.kw.song: The word before a song number in the Dangme workbook. Ga: "Lala".
notes.kw.bible_reading: Part title as printed. Ga: "Biblia Kanemɔ".
notes.kw.cbs: Part title as printed. Ga: "Asafoŋ Biblia Nikasemɔ".
notes.kw.gems: Part title as printed. Ga: "Pɛimɔ Ŋmalɛi Lɛ Amli Jogbaŋŋ".
notes.kw.starting: Part title as printed. Ga: "Kɛ́ Oyaaje Sanegbaa Shishi".
notes.kw.following: Part title as printed. Ga: "Kɛ́ Oyaatsa Nɔ".
notes.kw.what_say: Part title as printed, if the Dangme workbook has it. Ga: "Mɛni Obaakɛɛ?".
notes.kw.disciples: Part title as printed. Ga: "Kɛ́ Oofee Mɛi Kaselɔi".
notes.kw.beliefs: Part title as printed. Ga: "Gbalamɔ Ohemɔkɛyeli".
notes.kw.talk: A bare student "Talk" as printed. Ga: "Wiemɔ".
notes.kw.opening: As printed (if it has a heading). Ga: "Hiɛkpamɔ".
notes.day.short: Short day names, Monday first, separated by spaces.
notes.rem.msg_intro_one_plain: WhatsApp reminder, when no congregation name is set.
notes.rem.msg_intro_many_plain: WhatsApp reminder, when no congregation name is set.
notes.rem.msg_line: One line of the WhatsApp reminder.
notes.cal.description: Calendar entry text. {congregation} is ", " and the name, or nothing.

notes.month.aux_col: Table column: whether the auxiliary classroom is in use.
notes.month.until: An assembly or convention that runs to a later date.
notes.print.scope: Read aloud to screen readers for the one meeting / whole month switch.
notes.print.card_alt: Read aloud to screen readers for the card picture.
notes.print.person_count: A name with how many parts they have that month.
notes.rem.line: One part on a reminder card.
notes.rem.line_assisting: One part on a reminder card.
notes.people.inactive_suffix: After a name in the list of participants.
notes.people.clash_line: One meeting in the "reassign these" list.
notes.admin.your_name_hint: Hint under "Your name" in Admin > Settings
notes.part.minutes: After a part title on screen, e.g. "Bible Reading (4 min)". The Dangme workbook writes “Hɛngm.”
notes.rot.flag_inactive: After a name in the list of people to pick, e.g. "Kofi Mensah — 3 weeks ago · inactive".
notes.rot.flag_away: After a name in the list of people to pick.
notes.rot.flag_suspended: After a name in the list of people to pick.
notes.rot.tag_child: After a name in the list of people to pick: this person is a child.
notes.rot.tag_youth: After a name in the list of people to pick: this person is a young person.
notes.rot.tag_new: After a name in the list of people to pick: a new student.
notes.rot.assisted: What someone last did, e.g. "assisted, Bible Reading".
notes.rot.assisting: What someone does next, e.g. "assisting, Making Disciples".
notes.card.chip_parts: On the week's share card: how many parts the week has.
notes.card.chip_assignments: On one person's share card: how many assignments they have that month.
notes.doc.s140_minutes: On the S-140, before the minutes: “(Min. 10)”. The Dangme S-140 writes “Hɛngm.”
